actions.action: Preserve permission changes as dated events
actions.mechanism: An append-only history separates past authorization from withdrawals affecting future display.
actions.implementation: Record grants and withdrawals against asset IDs and venue/date scopes, with effective times, recording times, actor IDs, and links to preceding records.
actions.check: Withdraw a future date; confirm its permission fails while an earlier authorized display and its supporting record remain visible.
actions.risk: Ambiguous effective times require review, not silent interpretation.

actions.action: Require a venue-specific check before display
actions.mechanism: A current installation gate prevents delivered or packed prints from being treated as automatically authorized.
actions.implementation: At installation, scan the asset ID and check the intended venue and display interval against current permissions. Log the result; hold installation if verification is unavailable.
actions.check: Deliver an authorized print, withdraw permission, then attempt installation; the venue must receive a blocked result.

actions.mechanism: Cached permissions support packing, but reconciliation—not the packing decision—controls release for installation.
actions.implementation: Download versioned venue/date permissions before the offline workday. Queue packing decisions with asset IDs and snapshot versions; reconcile every entry on reconnection and hold conflicts.
actions.check: Withdraw permission during an offline packing day; synchronization must flag the packed print and prevent installation clearance.
actions.risk: Staff may mistake a cached approval for installation permission.

actions.action: Track withdrawn prints through physical custody
actions.mechanism: Custody records turn permission changes into actionable holds wherever a print is located.
actions.implementation: Link asset IDs to containers, shipments, and current custodians. On withdrawal, issue a hold task for affected future displays and require acknowledgment after physical segregation.
actions.check: Withdraw a print already packed for another venue; trace its container and confirm the receiving team records its segregation.
actions.risk: Unrecorded container moves can misdirect hold tasks.

actions.action: Invalidate clearance when exhibition plans change
actions.mechanism: Permission belongs to the actual venue and dates, not merely the asset or exhibition name.
actions.implementation: Bind clearance to asset ID, venue ID, display interval, and plan revision. Editing location or dates removes clearance and requires a fresh permission check.
actions.check: Move a cleared print to another venue or extend its dates; installation must remain blocked unless the revised scope is authorized.
actions.risk: Duplicate venue identifiers can produce incorrect scope matches.

actions.action: Keep public labels separate from permission administration
actions.mechanism: A minimal public identifier enables asset lookup without exposing contributor contact details or private administrative records.
actions.implementation: Print the asset ID on the public label; use an authenticated staff interface for permission verification. Exclude contributor contacts from label templates and public lookup responses.
actions.check: Generate labels and inspect unauthenticated lookup responses; neither may reveal contributor contact information, while staff can verify venue/date permission.
actions.risk: Free-text label fields can accidentally disclose contact details.

actions.mechanism: Preplanned alternatives let staff replace a held print without bypassing permission controls or improvising substitutions.
actions.implementation: Maintain optional replacement assets for each exhibition slot, including dimensions and venue/date permission records. Require current verification of the selected replacement before installation.
actions.check: Withdraw the primary asset; demonstrate replacement selection and verification. If every alternative is unauthorized, leave the slot empty.
actions.risk: An alternative’s earlier approval may also become outdated.

actions.mechanism: Installation approval does not silently authorize later dates after permission expires or a future withdrawal takes effect.
actions.implementation: Record installed assets and planned removal times. Recheck permission before each display day and at effective permission boundaries; assign removal or covering tasks when authorization ends.
actions.check: Set permission to end before a later exhibition day; confirm the installed print is removed or covered before that unauthorized period.
actions.risk: Unacknowledged tasks require escalation to the venue operator.
